protocol.models: Existing frozen checkpoints used in the published Strength/Speed decision diagnostics; no new training or checkpoint selection.
protocol.strength: All 256 native query pairs for each available published action-selection checkpoint (10 schemes); reconstruct exact paired errors from stored records.
protocol.speed_native: All 300 scenes in each of four speed tracks for LeWM T0/T1; use saved prediction/target at the original query action (candidate index 20), not a model-selected action.
protocol.speed_horizon: All six previously registered scenes, all candidates in all four existing arms, and raw steps 5/10/15/20/25; same future actions for every hidden speed. Correct and wrong histories differ only in matched-condition assignment.
protocol.metrics: Complete error divided by energy around the condition-mean target; decomposition into response error and common bias; wrong-history error and wrong-minus-correct error with the same denominator.
protocol.weighting: Conditions and candidates have equal weight within each scene; accumulate numerator/denominator energies across scenes before taking ratios. This is target-separation-energy weighting, not the mean of per-scene ratios. Never pool different speed tracks or action arms.
protocol.uncertainty: 10000 percentile scene-cluster bootstrap resamples, seed 20260929; conditions/candidates/depths remain paired. Checkpoint-conditional query uncertainty, not training-seed uncertainty.
protocol.zero_separation: Keep zero-separation candidate groups in all sums and report their count; an entirely zero aggregate denominator is undefined, never replaced with epsilon.
protocol.interpretation: Native latent prediction quality relative to an ideal condition-blind mean predictor, not physical-state error. The mean is a scoring-only hindsight reference. History benefit is algebraically related to response gain, not independent evidence.
protocol.frozen_results: No modification of archived selection, response or CEM scores; these are additional post-hoc diagnostics.

new_inference_scope: Only LeWM Strength T0 original query actions; all other predictions reused.
availability: Aggregates and per-scene error energies are included here. Original prediction arrays/records are identified by hashes; no new public dataset release is implied.
